title: NullPointerException in OrderProcessor.calculateTotal for addressless customers
description: OrderProcessor.calculateTotal throws java.lang.NullPointerException when a customer has no saved shipping address. Introduced in order-service v2.3.1 by a refactor that removed a null guard.
workaround: Have the customer add any shipping address before checkout; fix is deployed in v2.3.2.

title: Kafka client rebalance storm on librdkafka 1.9.x under high partition count
description: Consumer groups using librdkafka 1.9.x experience repeated, unnecessary rebalances when the topic has more than 100 partitions, causing consumer lag spikes during rebalance windows.
workaround: Pin librdkafka to 1.8.2 until upgraded; increase session.timeout.ms to reduce spurious rebalances.

title: IIS worker process crash on multipart uploads over 50MB
description: w3wp.exe crashes with an access violation when handling multipart/form-data uploads larger than ~50MB on IIS 10 with the ASP.NET Core Module v2.
workaround: Enforce a 50MB client-side upload limit until the AspNetCoreModuleV2 patch is applied.

title: Collector command queue stalls after mesh router firmware v3.4.0
description: Mesh routers upgraded to firmware v3.4.0 intermittently stop forwarding commands to downstream meter endpoints, causing CommandTimeout errors in the collector command log.
workaround: Hold firmware at v3.3.x; do not roll out v3.4.0 further until vendor patch is available.
